title: Пикар 400 м на Rust: крейт, итерация, сверка с ref/
goal: Крейт picard_rs (R3): базовые структуры (сетка, поля, граничные условия, состояние итерации) и полная итерация Пикара AM-01 на f32 с явным пулом rayon; блоки и решения 4 случаев ref/ совпадают с эталоном по допускам GPU-теста, результаты — R2 в out/.
scope: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/ — крейт picard_rs (кроме contract/): Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/, out/, README.md, .gitignore

accept.name: clippy
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R1 -- cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

accept.name: blocks_dev
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R1 -- cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml -- blocks tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/flat_wind.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/agnesi.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/heated_slope.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json

accept.name: solve_ref_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R1 -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in flat_wind agnesi heated_slope saddle; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/check_contract.py --results tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/flat_wind_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/agnesi_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/heated_slope_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/saddle_release_t8.json
